summary:
eBay is the auction and marketplace site at ebay.com. Sellers look up its favicon for listing tools and browser profiles. The sizes below were read from the files that downloaded, not from a generic chart.

Checked 12 November 2026 against ebay.com. HTML came from https://www.ebay.com/ (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.ebay.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 1150 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://pages.ebay.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 60×60 png.

Brand colour #ffeeee comes from the most common non-white pixel in png-60x60-01.png, quantised to 4 bits per channel.

Largest measured bitmap: png-60x60-01.png at 60×60 (png, 2517 bytes) from https://pages.ebay.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
